name: AllUnity CHF
who_can_redeem: Holders have a statutory redemption right against AllUnity at par value. Direct mint-platform access is limited to onboarded institutional and professional clients, and operational redemption remains subject to current terms and compliance controls.
redemption_region_notes: AllUnity markets the product to legal entities and business customers. A statutory holder redemption right is not the same as unrestricted retail access to the direct mint platform.
redemption_notes: Official AllUnity materials describe CHFAU as redeemable 1:1 at par, fully backed by segregated CHF reserves, and issued as a MiCAR electronic-money token.
summary: Swiss-franc-referenced electronic-money token issued by AllUnity, launched in February 2026 with segregated reserve backing, statutory par redemption, and verified Ethereum and Tempo deployments.
notes: PR #429 complete-record promotion. Network expansion, reserve-report series, operational fee terms, and legal-protection details remain explicit known unknowns.

name: AllUnity SEK
who_can_redeem: Holders have a statutory redemption right against AllUnity at par value. Businesses may access direct mint and redemption through the AllUnity Business Mint Account subject to onboarding and current terms.
redemption_region_notes: AllUnity directs the product to legal entities and business customers. Direct platform access and general holder redemption rights are recorded separately.
redemption_notes: Official AllUnity materials describe SEKAU as redeemable 1:1 at par, fully backed by segregated Swedish-krona reserves, and issued as a MiCAR electronic-money token.
summary: Swedish-krona-referenced electronic-money token issued by AllUnity, launched in June 2026 with segregated reserve backing, statutory par redemption, and verified Ethereum, Polygon, Base, and Solana deployments.
notes: PR #429 complete-record promotion. Tempo identifier, current circulation, reserve-report series, and operational fee terms remain explicit known unknowns.
